title: Hiveborn
wikitext:
{{for|the support gem|Hiveborn Support}}
'''Hiveborn''' are a species of monsters that are associated with [[Breach (Keepers league)|Breach]] mechanic. They were introduced in the [[Keepers league]] and replacing the [[Breach (original)|original Breach]] monsters in next leagues.

They can be encountered before and during a [[Breach Hive]] encounter, during an [[Unstable Breach]] encounter, and in a [[Hive Fortress]] or [[Hive Colony]].
